name: Sand Lizard
flavour: Blue blood. Warm sand. Fast feet.
art_prompt: a goofy fat desert lizard running on four short legs, bright cobalt blue scales with dark navy stripes down its back and a pale sky-blue belly, a long tail, a wide flat head with big round eyes and a wide toothy grin, standing on the ground
motion: scurrying in place on four short legs, tail whipping side to side
doc: The runner: a fat blue lizard nearly as fast as an ant with a goblin's bite, so a pack closes before a slow build can turn.
